label: Artemis II Mission Status
delta: Day 41 post-splashdown: IFT-12 LAUNCH DAY — 6:30 PM EDT tonight from Pad 2. Crew at JSC. Artemis III 460 km profile confirmed. VAB stacking continues.
deltaNote: Day 41: Artemis II crew at JSC Houston. IFT-12 (Starship V3, Booster 19 + Ship 39) at OLP-2 Starbase — launch window opens tonight at 6:30 PM EDT (22:30 UTC). After two schedule slips (May 19 delay to May 21), vehicle is fully stacked and GO at Pad 2. Ship 39 carries first-ever Starship docking port + propellant-transfer hardware, a NASA-required precursor for Artemis III HLS qualification. IFT-12 is the first flight of Raptor 3 engines (33 on Booster 19) and the inaugural launch from OLP-2. Artemis III mission profile (May 14): Orion rendezvous with Starship HLS + Blue Moon Mk2 at ~460 km LEO — targeting late 2027. Artemis IV (first crewed landing) confirmed 2028. Orion heat shield visual inspection ongoing at KSC MPPF; Marshall X-ray scans summer 2026.
